theorems.statement: ∀ (a b : Option RouteGuard.Iface), RouteGuard.allowed RouteGuard.Want.any a b = Bool.true
theorems.name: RouteGuard.any_always_allowed

theorems.statement:
∀ (a b : Option RouteGuard.Iface),
  RouteGuard.allowed RouteGuard.Want.direct a b = Bool.true →
    a ≠ Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.vpn ∧ b ≠ Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.vpn
theorems.name: RouteGuard.direct_never_through_vpn

theorems.statement:
∀ (a b : Option RouteGuard.Iface),
  RouteGuard.allowed RouteGuard.Want.vpn a b = Bool.true →
    a ≠ Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.phys ∧ b ≠ Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.phys
theorems.name: RouteGuard.vpn_never_direct

theorems.statement:
∀ (a : Option RouteGuard.Iface),
  RouteGuard.allowed RouteGuard.Want.direct a (Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.vpn) = Bool.false ∧
    RouteGuard.allowed RouteGuard.Want.vpn a (Option.some RouteGuard.Iface.phys) = Bool.false
theorems.name: RouteGuard.one_wrong_address_refuses

theorems.statement: ∀ (w : RouteGuard.Want), w ≠ RouteGuard.Want.any → RouteGuard.allowed w Option.none Option.none = Bool.false
theorems.name: RouteGuard.unresolved_refused

theorems.statement: ∀ (w : RouteGuard.Want), ∃ a, RouteGuard.allowed w a Option.none = Bool.true
theorems.name: RouteGuard.every_kind_passable
